fields.quote: The Torneo Clausura is the second and final tournament of the 2026 season, being held from 17 July to 22 November 2026.
fields.note: Phase row: this is the Clausura, one half of the split Apertura/Clausura season; 22 November 2026 is the last Clausura matchday. The season infobox still says only '30 January – December 2026' because the title play-offs follow in December, outside this phase.

fields.quote: Fecha de inicio 27 de marzo ... Fecha de cierre noviembre de 2026
fields.note: Liga 2 is a calendar-year league with no Apertura/Clausura split; the record was inherited from the Liga 1 article and never described this competition. Closing is given as a month only. Play-off rounds are ranges (14–15 and 21–22 November, 28–29 November and 5–6 December) with the subcampeonato on 9 December, so there is no single exact end day.

fields.quote: Fecha de inicio 30 de mayo ... Fecha de cierre noviembre de 2026
fields.note: Liga 3 is a calendar-year league with no Apertura/Clausura split; the record was inherited from the Liga 1 article and never described this competition. Only the closing month is published; the regional/final phases and play-offs (cuartos, semifinal, final) carry no single exact end day.
